Read AGENTS.md, docs/HANDOVER.md, docs/STATUS.md and docs/TASKS.md before making changes. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. The runnable app is the 0.4.0 rebuild; historical old-app features and test counts are not current implementation evidence. Update the handover/task status at a tested, pushed checkpoint and distinguish source/browser/static APK tests from Android runtime results. Never commit credentials or private signing keys.
